0.content: The Unseen Razor was the flat, razor-sharp sword of Lan's older brother Huo Zhaohui, a renowned martial artist and weaponsmith. After he was lost, the sword was not found with him. Lan searches for it through Guild commissions. The Traveler recovered its hilt in the Follow-Up Version of the commission "Where Is the Unseen Razor?". She wants to reforge it, but its blueprint is lost.

1.content: In this Version 7.0 event (2026-08-28 to 2026-09-14), Lan and Talalikhin invited the Traveler to Guild headquarters in Snezhnaya and a tournament. Lan was treating Iris to drinks between matches and used the occasion to talk about commission rank, a proposed difficulty score and the upcoming meeting on the topic. Later she headed north of Svetloledovka with Talalikhin to follow up leads on her brother.
